native_retrieval.snippet: # Kerala High Court grants anticipatory bail to Marunadan Malayali Editor Shajan Scaria in hate speech case. Scaria was booked for hate speech and hurting religious sentiments after an interaction with a Christian priest through his YouTube channel. Shajan Scaria and Kerala High CourtFacebook. The Kerala High Court on Thursday granted anticipatory bail to Shajan Scaria, editor of the online portal Marunadan Malayali booked for hate speech and hurting religious sentiments after an interaction with a Christian priest through his YouTube channel ***[Shajan Scaria v State of Kerala & Ors.].***.
